Basic Skill Tree #
Most skills are learned by using a skill items, such as an Orb or Book. However, some skills are bound to items or learned from completing quests!
Select a [Skill] from the [Basic Skill Tree] to preview the details of the skill.
Poison
ATK Skill
Deal poison damage to the target. It has a chance to deal additional poison damage over time.
  • Skill DMG: 12
  • Skill DMG +1 per 50 ENE Levels

  • Mana cost: 42
This skill can be learned via Scroll of Poison.

Master Skill Tree #
The Master Skill Tree is unlocked when a character completes the 3rd Class Upgrade quest! Each character level gained after level 400 will earn one Master Skill Point which can be applied to any of the Master Skill Trees!.
Select a [Master Skill] from the [Green Skill Tree] to preview the details of the skill.
